description: Spatially Aggregated IEEE Power Outage Data for the United States is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Heide Caswell, Tyler Jones (Public Utility Commission, State of Oregon). The IEEE power outage dataset for the United States provides outage-related data aggregated at the North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) region level from 1989 to 2023. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
